units.title: assignments
examples: point group from combining a 4-bar axis with a perpendicular 2-fold
radius ratio and preferred coordination of Si, Al, Mg, Ca, Na with oxygen; Pauling's second rule in spinel, olivine, perovskite
radius-ratio rule: ideal cation radius for coordination numbers 3–12

units.title: lab7_diffraction
examples: d-spacing and 2θ of (100) and (201) in orthorhombic forsterite for Cu Kα
d-spacings of three peaks from their 2θ (Bragg) for two candidate cells
primitive, face- or body-centred cubic from a diffraction pattern

units.title: lab12_hardness
examples: Knoop hardness of the Mohs minerals and its plot against Mohs number

units.title: lab13_optics1
examples: behaviour of quartz, feldspars and micas on rotating the stage in plane and crossed polars
which crystal systems are isotropic, uniaxial or biaxial

units.title: lab16_optics4
examples: optic sign and 2V of a biaxial mineral from an interference figure

units.title: lab2_plane_sym
examples: multiplicity of general and special positions in plane group p4m
point group of pictured objects; mirror angles that make 1m–6mm with a letter motif
unit cell and plane group of a pattern
